resolution.note: The verdict counts distinct assistant messages of the session transcript; the field is dropped when no transcript is found.

title: The lane verdict turn count matches the session transcript
body:
Why: lane t-cencnmk (0771942) printed `turns 1` after 1747 s, while its transcript ~/.claude/projects/-mnt-storage-coding-krn-active-krn--krn-worktrees-check-name-owner/fa1a426f-*.jsonl has 22 distinct assistant messages; lanes t-zyqmqx2 and t-q3y4re2 printed 23 and 22. num_turns from `claude -p` is not a reliable turn count (likely reset by --fallback-model or a retry).
Outcome: the lane verdict turn count equals the distinct assistant messages of the session transcript, or the field is dropped when the two disagree.
Proof: a test on a verbatim capture of that session result plus its transcript; npm run fast PASS.
